title: Kobe Fresh Outta High School Brings the heat to hip-hop with his latest Track, "TPA - ATL"
htmlContent:
American-based Hip hop artist Kobe Fresh Outta High School is a multi-talented rapper and songwriter who has taken time to learn all he needs to know about his craft to improve. Kobe Fresh Outta High School continues to cement himself as a trailblazer with the release of his latest single, "TPA - ATL."

Kobe Fresh Outta High School's "TPA - ATL" is an awesome record with a digestible sound that anyone can appreciate and the essence that will keep people coming back for a lifetime.
